unsupported: The family-owned business, now in its fifth generation, began as a textile fabrication shop serving the port city's maritime and industrial needs.

Its capabilities span five branded lines: ETP Environmental produces site-specific liners and containment curtains for water and ecology projects; ETP Industrial supplies tarps, curtains, and covers for facility optimization and asset protection; ETP Artcraft Awnings delivers commercial and residential shade structures; ETP Sports outfits track-and-field, baseball, and gym facilities with surfacing and padding; and ETP Racemarks provides elite course marking and branding for regattas and triathlons.
The client base ranges from federal agencies and municipal utilities to private contractors and recreational organizations.

Known for: Custom-fabricated textile solutions tailored to exact specifications; Five generations of family-owned expertise since 1877; Nationwide distribution and global export capability; Site-specific environmental liners and containment curtains; Champion-grade sports surfacing and water-event course marking
